knownIssues.text: The original pressurized plastic coolant reservoir can deteriorate. A leak can cause coolant loss and overheating. Frequency is unknown.

prevention.text: Have the reservoir and coolant system inspected for deterioration, leakage and proper operation.

driving.text: The six-speed and steering remain satisfying. The NC is more substantial and relaxed than the light early Miata.

styling.text: Broad arches give it a planted stance. The taller, rounder body looks less delicate than the NA.
